experiment_data.hypothesis: A frozen logistic regression probe trained on exp-001 calibration activations, used as continuous R1 signal (R1 = 1.0 - P(sycophantic)), will achieve comparable sycophancy reduction to DC-GRPO's direction-projection R1, because the probe captures the same linear separability in hidden states. If probe ≈ DC-GRPO, the directional signal adds no value beyond what binary classification provides; if DC-GRPO > probe, the continuous magnitude information in activation projections is the critical differentiator.
